title: SAML 2.0: Automatic EntityID normalization and robust metadata parsing for setup wizard
creator: Marcus Nguyen
description:
Problem: Customers frequently provide SAML metadata with minor but critical variations (trailing slashes, entityID as URL vs urn, multiple Certificate elements, whitespace or XML comments, missing protocol binding attributes). The current setup wizard rejects many of these inputs leading to poor onboarding experience and support tickets.

Goal: Enhance the SAML setup wizard to automatically normalize common entityID/URL variations, tolerate and canonicalize metadata with harmless differences, support multiple signing/encryption certificates, surface clear remediation steps for real errors, and produce structured validation output that feeds audit logs. This should reduce manual support, lower failed provisioning rates, and ensure auditability of admin actions during SSO setup.

Scope: wizard frontend UX + backend metadata ingestion/parsing + validation service + audit logging hooks. Does not include IdP provisioning APIs or SAML runtime integration changes beyond metadata storage and verification behavior.

High-level approach: 1) Implement entityID normalization rules (trim trailing slash, canonicalize http/https scheme for common IdP providers, support urn: formats) and deterministic hashing for stable keys. 2) Use a tolerant XML parser that strips XML comments and benign whitespace while preserving certificate and entity descriptors. 3) Support federation-metadata style multiple X509Certificate nodes and choose the most recently valid certificate by NotBefore/NotAfter when present; if none, fall back to fingerprint verification with admin prompt. 4) Provide a validation response model (structured, machine-friendly) containing: normalized_entity_id, warnings(list), errors(list), certificate_chain_status, binding_support(list). This model is persisted as a JSON blob and emitted to audit logs for the admin action. 5) Wizard UX changes: show a two-column preview (original metadata vs normalized canonical metadata), actionable warnings (e.g., missing POST binding), and one-click re-try with recommended defaults. 6) Add server-side caching of metadata fetch with TTL and ETag support to avoid transient network errors during exchange.

Security and audit requirements: each metadata ingestion or admin override must generate an immutable audit record with who/when/source/normalized_payload/decision. Sensitive PEM content must be redacted in logs; only certificate fingerprints and NotBefore/NotAfter retained. Require security review before rollout.

Acceptance criteria: - Wizard accepts >95% of metadata samples collected from 50 recent support tickets after normalization. - Validation model appears in audit logs for every setup action. - Admin UI shows side-by-side canonicalization preview and clear call-to-action to accept or reject changes. - Automated e2e test coverage for 12 common malformed-but-fixable metadata patterns. - Feature gated behind "saml_metadata_robustness" feature flag with gradual rollout.

Metrics to monitor: percentage of SSO setup failures before/after, number of support tickets referencing "metadata", rate of admin overrides, audit log volume and size.

Rollback plan: feature flag off reverts UX and parsing behavior. Preserve previously-stored metadata keys so existing connections continue to function.

Notes: collaborate with UX on copy for warnings, with security for redaction rules, and with customer success to collect additional failing metadata samples.
